svg.title: OpenFilm release readiness evidence snapshot
svg.desc: On main at 73f9df9, source CI, rendering and Windows recovery passed. The latest public version is 0.4.0 while package metadata says 1.0.0. Draft PR 129 has passing Verify, dependency advisory, Windows recovery and DCO checks. Candidate Render QA and the GLib unsound advisory remain open. Native installers and physical workstation claims have not been validated.
